faq.q: What makes a good spotted dolphin name?
faq.a: A good name matches personality, is easy to pronounce, and ideally 1-2 syllables.

faq.q: Should I name based on appearance?
faq.a: Yes! Distinctive features make wonderful naming inspiration.

faq.q: Can I use a human name?
faq.a: Absolutely. Human names are popular and make bonds feel more personal.
Shortlist 3-5 favorites, test them over several days.
Names ending in vowel sounds, especially 'ee', work best for recognition.

faq.q: How do I find a unique name for my Spotted Dolphin?
faq.a: Unique names often come from less obvious sources: scientific names (e.g., Panthera), foreign languages, obscure mythology, musical terms, or personal memories. Observe your Spotted Dolphin's quirks — a distinctive behavior or marking can inspire a one-of-a-kind name nobody else will have.

faq.q: Should my Spotted Dolphin's name reflect their species?
faq.a: It can, but it doesn't have to. Some owners love species-referential names (''Stripes'' for a zebra, ''Fin'' for a fish), while others prefer names that contrast playfully (''Tiny'' for a large animal). Let your Spotted Dolphin's individual personality guide you more than their species label.
